description: Serial, Serial1, Serial2 and Serial3 of the Mega 2560: greeting of every port, input to each port, echo in upper case.
basis: HardwareSerial of arduino:avr@1.8.8 on USART0 to USART3 (Serial = USART0, Serial1 = USART1, ...): every port keeps its own receive buffer and sends over its own pins; the input of one port reaches that port only; the sketch prints the greeting and echoes in upper case; Serial1 at 9600, Serial2 at 19200 and Serial3 at 57600 baud deliver their bytes in the order of the stimuli, 20 ms apart
